blind.description: A stylized fantasy or medieval cylindrical dovecote constructed from tan/sandstone masonry bricks. It features a small arched wooden door with iron bands at the ground level, several rows of small arched pigeon holes with extended white perching ledges around the upper body, and a tiered conical terracotta-shingled roof surmounted by a small wooden cupola/lantern with a pointed cap and ball finial.
blind.from_above: A concentric series of round terracotta shingle rings forming a circular roof cone, tapering up to a small central round cap topped with a round finial knob.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.3 to 1.4 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 7.5 to 8 ft tall), and roughly 4.5 to 5 ft wide at the eaves.
